name: Read weather forecast by ZIP code
description: Looks up the local weather forecast for a given US ZIP code on a weather forecasting site and reads the current temperature in Fahrenheit (alongside its current-conditions label) and tonight's forecast text from the 7-day outlook. Use this when an agent needs quick current-weather and short-term forecast details for a specific ZIP code.

inputs.name: zipCode
inputs.description: The US ZIP code to look up the local weather forecast for.

outputs.name: currentTemperatureF
outputs.description: The current temperature in Fahrenheit, alongside its current-conditions label (e.g. Overcast).

outputs.name: tonightForecastText
outputs.description: The forecast text for tonight from the 7-day outlook, including chance of precipitation, sky conditions, low temperature, and wind.
